name: Sacituzumab govitecan
mechanism: Humanised anti-TROP2 antibody linked via a hydrolysable CL2A linker to SN-38, the active metabolite of irinotecan and a topoisomerase I inhibitor. The labile linker allows payload release in the tumour microenvironment, contributing a bystander effect.
monitoring: Blood counts before each dose; consider growth factor support
Prompt management of diarrhoea (exclude infection; loperamide)
Premedication for infusion reactions and nausea
Consider UGT1A1 genotype; homozygosity for UGT1A1*28 increases neutropenia risk
interactions: Avoid UGT1A1 inhibitors and inducers, which alter SN-38 exposure.
resistance: TROP2 loss or mutation (e.g. TACSTD2 alterations), TOP1 mutations and payload efflux.
